title: Miniaturised transmissive multi-plane light converters via laser-written geometric phase holograms cascaded in glass
summary: Multi-plane light converters (MPLCs) are an emerging beam shaping technology capable of deterministically mapping a basis of input spatial light modes to a different basis of output modes. The ability to perform such multi-modal spatial reformatting operations has many future applications in both classical and quantum photonics, spanning from optical communications to photonic computing and advanced imaging.
